collection.title: Audi RS5 Sportback 2018 to 2025 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit the Audi RS5 Sportback 2018 onwards which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
